{'translation': 'Rumors of an improved Health app coming with iOS 26.4 swirled earlier this year. After a delay, the project was quietly shelved with iOS 27, never materializing.'}

{'translation': 'With the new Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 arriving next month, the question is: will these features debut alongside the new hardware?'}

{'translation': 'Precedent'}

{'translation': 'First, let us explore why these features will most likely arrive in September. You may be thinking: "Shouldn\'t all software be released in June?" In fact, there is precedent for this.'}

{'translation': "watchOS 9's Low Power Mode, watchOS 11's sleep apnea detection, and watchOS 26's hypertension notifications were all features that debuted in September, even though they did not require the latest hardware support."}

{'translation': "For these reasons, Apple is very likely waiting until September to unveil the next Health app upgrade, even if these features don't necessarily require brand-new Apple Watch hardware to function."}

{'translation': 'Time remains'}

{'translation': 'Before WWDC27, Bloomberg\'s Mark Gurman warned that a new Health app upgrade dubbed "Project Mulberry" might not be featured in the WWDC keynote. This prediction turned out to be accurate:'}

{'translation': 'Does this mean Project Mulberry will definitely appear at the September keynote? The answer is not necessarily. That said, given the past precedent of features launching in September, and knowing these features may arrive later than WWDC, a September debut is highly likely—though it could end up arriving in October as part of iOS 27.1.'}

{'translation': 'Feature recap'}

{'translation': 'Rumors surrounding these features have fluctuated because there are many variables at play. You may have heard there would be a standalone Health+ service featuring videos from doctors. However, that plan has reportedly been scaled back, with the features instead being integrated into the existing Health app experience.'}

{'translation': 'Two things, however, are clear: there will be an AI health coach that provides health tips based on your Health app data, and is able to use your camera to offer real-time suggestions on fitness and other health-related tasks. The other highlight of this upgrade is an entirely new Health app design that makes it easier to understand all your data.'}

{'translation': "Beyond that, we can only wait and see. Personally, I'm really looking forward to a better way to understand my Apple health data."}
